youtube_title: Your SIP Has a Hidden Commission 😳 #Shorts

Every mutual fund has a REGULAR and a DIRECT plan. Same fund, same manager, same portfolio. Regular plans include the distributor's commission in the expense ratio.

Illustration: ₹5,000/month for 20 years at an assumed 12% vs 11% = about ₹6 lakh difference. Not financial advice.
